messages:
maria_g: Quick thread — we need to lock down the cross-post plan for the webinar promo + benchmark narrative. Goal: drive signups, capture UTM'd leads, and route high-intent inbound to SDRs within 30m. Who can own assets, copy, and routing?

jake_p: I can own the X card + alt sizes. Need the benchmark stat and logo files. PNG and 1:1 for profile cards.

olivia_marketing: I’ll draft 3 copy options (short X, long X thread opener, and LinkedIn long form). Also can produce teaser clips if we get the recording. Proposed cadence below.

maria_g: Copy cadence idea — want to test a benchmark-led hook vs product-led hook. Rough schedule:
```
Mon 10:00am X (benchmark stat + CTA -> sign up)
Tue 2:00pm LinkedIn (long post, customer quote)
Wed 11:30am X thread (3 tweets: how we measured, result, CTA)
Thu 3:00pm X (reminder + short clip)
Fri 9:00am LinkedIn (final nudge + webinar registration)
```
Keep all posts UTM tagged: ?utm_source=social&utm_campaign=webinar_may2026&utm_medium=x_or_linkedin

sam_ops: Routing notes — Drift will capture initial contact, HubSpot will enrich. Rule proposal: if lead.form == "webinar_signup" AND lead.score >= 40 then Assign to SDR-Priority queue, else go to nurture list. HubSpot form id: `f9c2-web-2026`.

tom_sales: Important — SDR SLA needs to be 30m for priority leads. Who is the on-call for this sequence? We should also auto-create a Slack alert to #sales-inbound.
drift-bot: New capture event will post to #marketing-inbound when form `f9c2-web-2026` is submitted. Configure in Drift > Playbooks > Webinars.

jake_p: Asset checklist for design: 1) benchmark stat PNG 1200x675, 2) 1:1 square 1080x1080, 3) 16:9 short clip 15s, 4) alt copy overlay file. Will aim for first drafts today EOD.

olivia_marketing: Copy variants (short):
- Variant A: "We cut inference cost by 3.8x — see how. Free webinar + benchmark breakdown. Register: <link>"
- Variant B: "Latency vs cost: our benchmark shows the sweet spot. Join our engineers on May 18. RSVP: <link>"
- Variant C: "Benchmarks, tradeoffs, and real config examples. Webinar — sign up: <link>"
Which should be the test headline?

maria_g: Use Variant A for the benchmark-led test, Variant B for product-led. Olivia — put these into the scheduler and label them `bench-test-a` and `prod-test-b`. Jake — tag assets with those labels.

sam_ops: For HubSpot routing I'll push the workflow: source == social AND campaign == webinar_may2026 => if lead.score >= 40 then assign to `sdr_priority` and send Slack @here to #sales-inbound with `lead.name` and `lead_link`. Otherwise add to list `webinar_followup_2026`. I’ll attach the playbook YAML in the doc.

maria_g: Two followups: 1) Who writes the LinkedIn long post? (Olivia) 2) Who will monitor comments/threads for engaging replies? (Tom + SDR rotation)

tom_sales: SDRs will split shifts. I’ll create a rota and share. Also want a short reply library for rapid responses (pricing question, dedicated capacity, security).

oj: quick Q — any paid amplification budget?

maria_g: Yes — small test: $1k total, split 60/40 X/LinkedIn. Sam, please add conversion pixels for measurement.

sam_ops: done — pixel tag: `rdw_pixel_2026_web`. I’ll add tracking to all UTM URLs.

maria_g: Great. Action items:
- Jake: deliver asset variations (due today EOD)
- Olivia: schedule copy in scheduler + LinkedIn post (due tomorrow AM)
- Sam: implement HubSpot routing + Slack alerts (due today EOD)
- Tom: SDR rota + reply library (due tomorrow noon)
We’ll review live at 4pm in #marketing-ops. :thumbsup:

jake_p: On it.

olivia_marketing: Got it. I’ll link drafts in the thread when ready.

sam_ops: Will post workflow YAML to the doc and ping once live.

maria_g: Thanks team — assigning the thread to owners. Ping me if blockers.
